description: Brings a tab to the front of its Chrome window. Changes what the user sees, so use only when the user wants it. (Background tabs can be read, operated and captured; no need to bring them forward to work.)

agent.description: Your display name, shown to other agents. Subagents must always set it. Default "claude-d26d".

slot.description: Browser slot 1-30. "3", "slot 3", "browser 3" → 3. If the user gives a port like 14052, subtract 14049.

tab.description: Tab to bring forward: number or ID

name: browser_tab_select
title: Bring tab to front
